routeError.title: This screen didn't load.
routeError.body: Nothing saved on this tablet was lost. Check the internet, then reload.

register.title: Set up this tablet once.
register.intro: Pick what this screen is for. It stays ready for your staff from then on.
register.question: What is this screen for?

pos.name: Billing counter
pos.hint: Take orders, print bills and KOTs. Works without internet.

kds.name: Kitchen display
kds.hint: Shows tickets to the kitchen. Needs internet.

register.stubNote: Owner sign-in and device pairing are not built yet; this choice is stored on this device only.

offline.body: Keep billing as usual. Bills are saved on this tablet and sync on their own when the internet is back. QR and Swiggy/Zomato orders are paused.

clock.title: This tablet's clock is behind its last bill.
clock.body: Billing is paused so no bill gets the wrong date. Set the correct date and time in the tablet's settings; billing starts again on its own.

storage.title: Bills on this tablet are not protected yet.
storage.install: Add Bhojnalya to the Home Screen and open it from there, or Safari may delete bills that have not synced.
storage.persist: The browser may delete saved bills when the tablet runs low on space. Install the app so they are kept.

unsynced.heading: Changes not synced yet
unsynced.none: Everything on this tablet has synced.
unsynced.count_one: {{count}} change has not reached the server yet.
unsynced.count_other: {{count}} changes have not reached the server yet.
unsynced.refused_one: The server refused {{count}} of them; it stays on this tablet until you retry.
unsynced.refused_other: The server refused {{count}} of them; they stay on this tablet until you retry.

reset.heading: Clear or reset
reset.blocked_one: Blocked: {{count}} change has not synced yet. Connect to the internet and wait for it to sync, or export it first.
reset.blocked_other: Blocked: {{count}} changes have not synced yet. Connect to the internet and wait for them to sync, or export them first.
reset.clearHint: Removes bills, orders and the invoice series from this tablet. It must be paired again before it can bill.
reset.resetHint: Clears the data and goes back to set-up.
reset.cleared: Data on this tablet was cleared.

offline.body: Reconnecting… New tickets appear when the internet is back. Use the printed KOTs until then.
